title: 第二十五章 坚亥步天第二十六章 长右之噪
lines: 第二十五章：坚亥步天
沉默在冰晶阶梯上凝结，比千年玄冰更冷。
三个人，一条生路。
玄冥那双浑浊的冰蓝色眼睛静静地看着他们，没有催促，没有提示，仿佛早已料到这一刻。他只是将拐杖顿在冰面上，发出一声清脆的叩响，像是敲响了命运的丧钟。
“我来。”李元茜第一个开口，声音不大，却异常坚定，“我的研究，我的数据，都在这里。我必须回去，告诉世人这里发生的一切。哪怕没人信，哪怕我只是个疯子。”
“不。”黄海涛摇头，他看着李元茜，又看向石枭，“你留下。石枭是剡山的守护者，他不能走。而我……”
他顿了顿，深吸一口气：“我是地理学家。我走过的路最多，我对这个世界的地貌最熟悉。如果我回去了，我能画出最准确的地图，能找到那个‘门’在现实世界的坐标。这比单纯带回一段故事更有价值。”
“黄老师……”李元茜眼眶发红。
“别争了。”石枭突然打断他们，他拔出插在木筏上的赤铜短刀，刀尖对准自己的胸口，“按照剡山的规矩，这种时候，应该由最强壮的人，用最古老的方式来决定。”
他手腕一翻，刀尖就要刺下。
“住手！”一个声音从竖井的黑暗深处传来。
不是三人中的任何一个。
那声音苍老、疲惫，却带着一种不容置疑的威严。紧接着，一个身影从螺旋阶梯的阴影里缓缓走出。
那是一个身材矮小、佝偻着背的老人。他穿着一件破烂不堪的、依稀能看出是白色长袍的衣服，手里拄着一根用兽骨和金属拼接成的拐杖。他的脸布满皱纹，像风干的苹果，唯独那双眼睛，虽然浑浊，却依然闪烁着智慧的光芒。
“帝……帝台？”玄冥看到老人，竟然微微欠身，行了一个古老的礼节。
“玄冥，你老了，规矩也忘了。”老人——帝台，缓缓走到三人面前，目光在三人身上一一扫过，“用命来赌？愚蠢。那是蛮人的做法。”
他抬起枯瘦的手，指向黄海涛手中的核心碎片：“这东西，不是钥匙，是‘秤砣’。它打破了平衡，所以门才会只能过一个人。”
他又指向那条冰晶阶梯：“这条路，也不是给活人走的。它是‘忘川’，走上去，记忆就会像冰一样消融。就算回去了，也只会是一个失忆的疯子。”
“那怎么办？”黄海涛急切地问，“难道我们困死在这里？”
“有办法。”帝台嘴角露出一丝神秘的微笑，“但需要一个人，做一件自古至今，没人做过的事。”
他看向黄海涛：“年轻人，你熟悉地理。那你可知，这《山海经》里的山，为何能连成一片？”
“板块运动？大陆漂移？”黄海涛下意识回答。
“不。”帝台摇头，“是因为‘步天’。有一个人，他用双脚丈量了天地，把散落的山川，用脚步串联起来。他叫竖亥。”
“竖亥？”李元茜脑中闪过《山海经》里的记载，“‘帝命竖亥步，自东极至于西极，五亿十选九千八百步。’”
“没错。”帝台点头，“他走过的路，就是这张网的‘经纬线’。只要能重现他的‘步天’之法，就能暂时‘缝合’这个破碎的世界，让‘归墟之门’重新稳定，容纳更多的人通过。”
“怎么做？”石枭问。
“需要一个人，带着‘核心’碎片，沿着竖亥当年的足迹，重新走一遍。”帝台看着黄海涛，“用你的双脚，去校准这个世界的‘坐标’。当你走完最后一站，门自然会为你敞开，而且，不再是单行道。”
“这需要多久？”黄海涛问。
“不知道。”帝台坦然道，“也许几天，也许几年。但你必须一个人走。而且，路上会有‘东西’阻拦你，它们不想让你把世界拼回去。”
他看向李元茜和石枭：“你们的任务，是帮他守住‘起点’。只要起点不灭，他的路就不会断。”
说完，帝台走到冰壁前，双手按在冰面上。他口中念念有词，那块刻着符文的冰壁竟然缓缓融化，露出一个通往地底的、更加深邃的洞口。
“这是‘步天之道’的起点。”帝台看向黄海涛，“去吧，地理学家。去丈量这个世界的伤痕。”
黄海涛看着那个深不见底的洞口，又看了看李元茜和石枭。
“等我。”他只说了这三个字，然后转身，义无反顾地走进了黑暗。

Chapter 25: Jian Hai Butian
1.
Silence condenses on the ice crystal steps, colder than the thousand-year-old black ice.
Three people, a way out.
Xuan Ming's turbid ice-blue eyes looked at them quietly, without urging or prompting, as if he had expected this moment. He just put his crutches on the ice and made a crisp knock, like ringing the death knell of fate.
"I'll come." Li Yuanqian spoke first, her voice not loud but extremely firm, "My research and my data are all here. I must go back and tell the world what happened here. Even if no one believes it, even if I am just a madman."
"No." Huang Haitao shook his head. He looked at Li Yuanqian and then at Shi Xiao, "You stay. Shi Xiao is the guardian of Yan Mountain, he can't leave. And I..."
He paused and took a deep breath: "I am a geographer. I have traveled the most roads, and I am most familiar with the landforms of this world. If I go back, I can draw the most accurate map and find the coordinates of the 'door' in the real world. This is more valuable than simply bringing back a story."
"Teacher Huang..." Li Yuanqian's eyes turned red.
"Stop arguing." Shi Xiao suddenly interrupted them. He pulled out the red copper knife inserted on the raft and pointed the tip of the knife at his chest. "According to the rules of Shanshan, at this time, the decision should be made by the strongest person using the oldest method."
As soon as he turned his wrist, the tip of the knife was about to stab.
"Stop!" a voice came from the dark depths of the shaft.
Not any of the three.
The voice was old and tired, but it carried an unquestionable majesty. Then, a figure slowly walked out from the shadow of the spiral staircase.
It was an old man with a short stature and a stooped back. He was wearing a tattered piece of clothing that could vaguely be seen as a white robe, and he was holding a crutch made of animal bones and metal. His face was wrinkled, like a dried apple, but his eyes, although cloudy, still shone with the light of wisdom.
"Emperor...Emperor Platform?" When Xuan Ming saw the old man, he bowed slightly and performed an ancient etiquette.
"Xuan Ming, you are old and have forgotten the rules." The old man, Di Tai, slowly walked up to the three of them and scanned them one by one. "Gamble with your life? Stupid. That is what barbarians do."
He raised his skinny hand and pointed at the core fragment in Huang Haitao's hand: "This thing is not a key, but a 'weight'. It breaks the balance, so only one person can pass through the door."
He pointed to the ice crystal staircase again: "This road is not for living people to walk. It is the 'River of Forgetfulness'. If you walk up it, your memory will melt like ice. Even if you go back, you will only be a lunatic with amnesia."
"What should we do?" Huang Haitao asked eagerly, "Are we trapped here?"
"There is a way." A mysterious smile appeared on Di Tai's lips, "But it takes one person to do something that no one has done since ancient times."
He looked at Huang Haitao: "Young man, you are familiar with geography. Then do you know why the mountains in "The Classic of Mountains and Seas" are connected together?"
"Plate movement? Continental drift?" Huang Haitao answered subconsciously.
"No." Di Tai shook his head, "It's because of 'Bu Tian'. There is a man who measured the world with his feet and connected the scattered mountains and rivers with his steps. His name is Shu Hai."
"Shuhai?" The record in "The Classic of Mountains and Seas" flashed through Li Yuanqian's mind, "'The Emperor ordered the Shuhai step, from the east pole to the west pole, choose 9800 steps from 500 million.'"
"That's right." Di Tai nodded, "The path he walked is the 'longitude and latitude' of this network. As long as his 'Bu Tian' method can be reproduced, this broken world can be temporarily 'stitched' together, allowing the 'Gate to Return to Ruins' to be stabilized again, allowing more people to pass through."
"How to do it?" Shi Xiao asked.
"It takes someone to take the 'core' fragments and walk along the footsteps of Shu Hai all over again." Di Tai looked at Huang Haitao, "Use your feet to calibrate the 'coordinates' of this world. When you finish the last stop, the door will naturally open for you, and it is no longer a one-way street."
"How long will this take?" Huang Haitao asked.
"I don't know." Di Tai said calmly, "Maybe a few days, maybe a few years. But you have to go alone. Moreover, there will be 'things' blocking you on the way. They don't want you to put the world back together."
He looked at Li Yuanqian and Shi Xiao: "Your mission is to help him guard the 'starting point'. As long as the starting point is immortal, his path will not be cut off."
After saying that, Di Tai walked to the ice wall and pressed his hands on the ice. As he muttered words, the ice wall engraved with runes slowly melted, revealing a deeper hole leading to the ground.
"This is the starting point of the 'Way of Stepping to Heaven'." Di Tai looked at Huang Haitao, "Go, geographer. Go and measure the scars of this world."
Huang Haitao looked at the bottomless hole, then at Li Yuanqian and Shi Xiao.
"Wait for me." He only said these three words, then turned around and walked into the darkness without hesitation.
